entities.name: Alexander Peresvet
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexander or Aleksandr Peresvet was a Russian Orthodox monk who fought in single combat with the Tatar champion Temir-Mirza, known in most Russian sources as Chelubey, at the opening of the Battle of Kulikovo on 8 September 1380. The two men killed each other.
